---
title: "Mac App Store Distribution"
description: "Build, sign and upload the sandboxed macOS app to the Mac App Store alongside the Developer ID beta."
updatedAt: "2026-11-16"
audience: developers
---

The macOS app ships through two independent channels from the same Flutter
target (`apps/mobile/macos`, bundle `com.tuturuuu.app.mobile`):

| Channel | Workflow | Entitlements | Signing | Updates |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Direct download beta | `desktop-beta.yaml` | `Runner/Release.entitlements` (not sandboxed) | Developer ID Application, notarized DMG | In-app updater (`DESKTOP_RELEASE_RUN_ID`) |
| Mac App Store | `mobile-deploy-stores.yaml` job `publish-macos-app-store` | `Runner/AppStore.entitlements` (App Sandbox) | Apple Distribution + Mac Installer Distribution `.pkg` | Mac App Store only |

The Mac App Store build shares the iOS App Store Connect record (same bundle
identifier, universal purchase), so its builds appear under the macOS platform of
that app.

## Selecting the store configuration

The Runner target's Release configurations sign with
`$(TUTURUUU_RELEASE_ENTITLEMENTS)`, which `Runner/Configs/AppInfo.xcconfig`
defaults to `Runner/Release.entitlements`. The store build overrides it only for
that invocation:

```bash
FLUTTER_XCODE_TUTURUUU_RELEASE_ENTITLEMENTS=Runner/AppStore.entitlements \
  flutter build macos --release --flavor production \
  --target lib/main_production.dart --dart-define=DESKTOP_STORE_CHANNEL=true
```

Flutter passes `FLUTTER_XCODE_*` variables to `xcodebuild` as build settings. A
custom setting name keeps CocoaPods targets untouched. `DESKTOP_STORE_CHANNEL`
compiles the direct-download updater out even if a release run id were passed;
Apple does not allow self-updating Mac App Store apps.

`Runner/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy` mirrors the iOS manifest and ships in both
channels. `Info.plist` declares `ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption = false` and
`LSApplicationCategoryType = public.app-category.productivity`.

## Sandbox decisions

| Feature or plugin | Sandboxed verdict |
| --- | --- |
| Supabase, API, Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, WebRTC, video, webviews (`flutter_inappwebview`, `desktop_webview_window`), `background_downloader` model downloads | Works; needs `network.client` |
| Meet collaboration preview proxy (`HttpServer.bind` on loopback) | Works; needs `network.server` |
| Camera (`camera`, `mobile_scanner`, Meet video) | Works; needs `device.camera` plus `NSCameraUsageDescription` |
| Microphone (`record`, Meet, voice input, `flutter_pcm_sound` output) | Works; needs `device.audio-input` plus `NSMicrophoneUsageDescription` |
| File pick/save (`file_picker`, `file_selector`, `image_picker`, attachments) | Works; needs `files.user-selected.read-write` |
| Hive cache, SQLite, shared preferences, local model store, temp files | Works; paths resolve inside the app container |
| Secure storage, Supabase session (`flutter_secure_storage`) | Works; `keychain-access-groups` `TEAM.com.tuturuuu.app.mobile` from the profile |
| Sign in with Apple | Works; needs `com.apple.developer.applesignin` in the profile |
| Passkeys and universal links (`passkeys`, `app_links` https) | Works; needs `associated-domains` (`webcredentials:`/`applinks:tuturuuu.com`) and the macOS app id in the hosted association file |
| Custom URL scheme sign-in callback (`CFBundleURLTypes`), Google sign-in, `url_launcher`, `share_plus` | Works without extra entitlements |
| Push (`firebase_messaging`) | Works; needs `com.apple.developer.aps-environment` (production) in the profile |
| Local notifications, `local_auth` (Touch ID), connectivity, device/package info, timezone | Works without extra entitlements |
| App Attest native integrity channel | Unavailable until App Attest is added to the App ID; the channel already reports `unsupported` |
| Local inference (`flutter_edge_ai_litertlm`) | Works; companion dylibs are staged before signing, no JIT entitlement |
| Direct-download updater (`desktop_update`, `hdiutil`, `/bin/sh` installer) | Disabled: `DESKTOP_STORE_CHANNEL=true` and no `DESKTOP_RELEASE_RUN_ID` |
| Launch at login, screen capture, global hotkeys | Not used by the macOS app |

Any new plugin that reads arbitrary paths, spawns processes, opens listening
sockets or adds a URL handler must update this table and, if needed,
`AppStore.entitlements` and the profile.

## Packaging and upload

`scripts/desktop-deployment/package-mac-app-store.mjs` takes the built app and:

1. verifies the provisioning profile is an unexpired macOS distribution profile
   for the team and bundle, and grants every non-sandbox entitlement requested;
2. renders `AppStore.entitlements` with the team prefix and application
   identifier, embeds the profile, stages local inference dylibs and macOS
   localizations;
3. imports the Apple Distribution and Mac Installer Distribution identities into
   a temporary keychain, signs Mach-O files and nested bundles inside out
   (helper executables inherit the sandbox), signs the app, verifies the signed
   entitlements, and builds a signed `.pkg` with `productbuild`.

The job then uploads with `xcrun altool --upload-app --type macos` using the same
App Store Connect API key as iOS. Entitlement and profile rules are covered by
`mac-app-store-entitlements.test.mjs`; `mobile-build-macos.yaml` builds the
sandboxed configuration and checks the signed entitlements, privacy manifest and
store metadata on every run.

## Enabling the channel

The job is skipped unless the repository variable `MAC_APP_STORE_ENABLED` is
`true`. Once it is enabled, the iOS deployment bundle must hold all Mac App
Store entries (`hydrate-bundle.mjs` exports `MAC_APP_STORE_READY`), or the job
fails. Enabling the channel promises a Mac build, and a skip would count the
tree as delivered, so the store gate would never retry the Mac upload. Add the
entries before setting the variable:

| Bundle entry | Kind | Exported as |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mac Installer Distribution certificate `.p12` | file `apple_mac_installer_certificate_p12` | `APPLE_MAC_INSTALLER_CERTIFICATE_P12_PATH` |
| Its password | scalar `APPLE_MAC_INSTALLER_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD` | `APPLE_MAC_INSTALLER_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD` |
| Mac App Store provisioning profile `.provisionprofile` | file `apple_mac_app_store_provisioning_profile` | `APPLE_MAC_APPSTORE_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_PATH` |

A partial set fails the job. The existing Apple Distribution certificate, team
id and App Store Connect API key are reused. The vault's file kinds and scalar
names are allowlisted, so adding these entries needs a vault schema and
validation update before the files can be stored.

Apple-side prerequisites: add the macOS platform to the App Store Connect app
record, create a Mac Installer Distribution certificate, and create a Mac App
Store provisioning profile for `com.tuturuuu.app.mobile` with the App ID's
Sign in with Apple, Associated Domains and Push Notifications capabilities.
